changelog: Edit Order is now a full editor: add an item that was missed, remove a wrong line, or change any item's quantity and rate — using the same Add Item builder as New Order. Discount, delivery and notes are editable too, and totals, tax and balance recalculate on save.
Removing a line that has no design work deletes it cleanly; a line that already has proofs is safely marked cancelled to keep the job history intact.
Order entry now accepts phone numbers in any format — spaces, +91, or a leading 0 are cleaned automatically and only the 10-digit number is kept.
When saving a new order a Yes/No popup asks whether to WhatsApp the customer the confirmation message; choose No to save silently (staff and designers are still notified either way).
